seal_verification: passed all39 predictions, manifest, scores and summary bindings
audit_scope: Post-hoc descriptive analysis of sealed coordinates and score counts only; no queries, patches, source bodies, reruns or tuning.

interpretation.evidence_level: Exploratory post-hoc description of a frozen 39-task/6-repository pilot; not confirmatory evidence.
interpretation.candidate_identity_limit: Raw outputs omit candidate spans, anchor IDs/source spans, rejection reasons, full frontier records and rendered payload. They retain delivery coordinates/counts and payload hashes. These suffice for delivery-set comparisons but cannot establish exact common candidate identity or diagnose dropped-anchor causes.
refuted_within_pilot: Fixed graph expansion improves the primary line-F1 metric over both strong lexical controls: not supported; declarations delta negative and planning gates false.
Graph expansion is an uncomplicated improvement over anchors-only: macro line-F1 decreases at all three budgets, with very small edit-label recall increments.
Successful worker or ready status establishes complete static closure: not supported; all34 graph predictions have nonzero frontiers.
A larger 32KB result can replace the frozen 16KB primary result: invalid post-hoc selection.
not_refuted_or_established: General usefulness of graph context for solving tasks: not tested; edited old lines are proxy labels, not uniquely required context.
Semantic relevance of non-edit source lines: unknown.
All possible graph methods fail: not tested.
Exact anchor identity for the other35 tasks is not independently audited; only the four discrepancy tasks were replayed. Metadata effects explain those five omissions, not the full quality deficit.

next_questions.question: On new disjoint tasks, can a predeclared selective dependency expansion policy increase edit-label recall over exact shared anchors and both same-file controls while preserving line-F1 at16KB?
next_questions.falsifier: No positive repository-macro recall effect, or a negative line-F1 effect, on independent sealed evaluation. Define confidence/advance thresholds before evaluation; current39 cannot be reused as heldout.
next_questions.status: Hypothesis generated after pilot; not tested.

next_questions.question: With a preregistered metadata treatment and all bytes charged, does graph content expansion still outperform the same-anchor and strong same-file controls on new tasks?
next_questions.falsifier: No positive prespecified effect under the fixed treatment, or conclusion reverses with the declared metadata sensitivity check.
next_questions.status: Post-hoc new question. The original five omissions are already explained by exact replay, not pending causal speculation.

next_questions.question: Does dependency expansion improve actual repair success under equal total context budgets even where removed-line overlap is low?
next_questions.falsifier: No repair-success gain or higher failure rate against strong lexical/same-file controls under the same pinned model, decoding, task tests and total budget.
controls: same pinned model and issue-only retrieval
next_questions.status: Requires separately authorized resources and independent evaluation; no repair experiment occurred.

next_independent_data_requirements: Treat current39 and prior development cases as exposed development evidence. Freeze disjoint repositories/tasks by metadata before viewing issues, patches or outcomes.
Verify dataset/code licenses and fixed source commits; inspect only source archive metadata for CPU/size eligibility before labels, then retain every selected task and all cap failures.

Require more independent repository clusters with balanced prespecified caps; determine sample size and uncertainty method before outcome inspection rather than treating702 dependent score rows as independent.
Prespecify handling of no-removed-line targets and non-Python edits; keep edit-localization proxy and repair success separate.

Retain privacy-safe anchor/candidate coordinates, candidate order, per-candidate acceptance/rejection reason, frontier kind counts, actual metadata/source byte breakdown and exact output hashes; do not publicly release source/issue bodies.

summary.kind: post-hoc deterministic replay diagnostics; not new holdout or independent validation

deterministic_replay_diagnostics.privacy_check: all diagnostic JSON records lack source/issue/patch string contents; trial field-size maps contain integer byte counts only
deterministic_replay_diagnostics.scope: Four previously exposed discrepancy tasks only; all72 payloads reproduced. Not a new holdout or independent validation.
